title: Data Visualization
summary: Charts make comparison, trend, distribution or relationship easier than raw values.

MUST.text: Choose chart by analytical task; include units, labels and meaningful baseline.

SHOULD.text: Provide accessible summary or data alternative and non-color distinction.

AVOID.text: Avoid 3D effects and truncated axes that exaggerate differences.

DECIDE.decision: Start at zero or justify truncation

EXAMPLE.good: Revenue line chart states date range, currency and axis scale with table alternative
EXAMPLE.bad: 3D pie chart with truncated axis and color-only legend

FAILURE_MODES: Truncated axes exaggerate differences; start at zero or justify.
Color-only encoding excludes color-blind users; add labels/patterns.
Missing text alternative blocks screen reader users; provide summary/table.
